verdict.rationale: Ramp's Bill Pay product documents end-to-end AP: OCR invoice capture (99% accuracy), two/three-way matching, rules-based approval routing, and payment via card, ACH, check, or wire (POST /bills documents 'payment method selected per bill — card (cashback), ACH, check, wire, and more'), plus ERP sync (NetSuite/QuickBooks/Xero) to complete the workflow in one platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party review of the AP workflow beyond vendor docs, and more detail on approval-routing UI specifics outside the API reference.
